The '''Kaikielius system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], near [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].
